about.heading: About
paragraphs: I'm a Software Engineering student at Karunya Institute of Technology and Sciences, passionate about building intelligent software that combines Artificial Intelligence, backend engineering, and thoughtful user experiences. I enjoy turning ambitious ideas into production-ready applications while constantly learning new technologies.

My current focus is on developing AI-powered productivity software, scalable backend architectures, and full-stack applications. I'm also strengthening my skills in Data Structures & Algorithms, System Design, and Competitive Programming to become a well-rounded software engineer.

projects.title: Athena
description: Building a full-stack productivity platform combining focus sessions, a task planner, adaptive streak tracking, and behavioral analytics.
Implemented secure authentication with JWT and OTP verification, and designed interactive dashboards to visualize productivity trends over time.

projects.title: ResQit
description: Built a disaster-response coordination system with role-based access for administrators, volunteers, and requesters.
Integrated PostgreSQL via JDBC and developed a JavaFX desktop interface with secure login and team-management features.
